q: The measurable dynamics of a rational map f is governed by the conformal measure μ supported on the Julia set J(f). For a polynomial of degree d, the natural conformal measure has exponent:
exp: The natural conformal measure (Patterson-Sullivan measure) has exponent δ = dim_H(J(f)): μ(f(A)) = ∫_A |f'|^δ dμ. For hyperbolic polynomials, δ = dim_H(J) and μ is ergodic, giving the 'canonical' measure on the Julia set.
